rules.rule: Every record is confirmed before filing; never file silently
must: Must\ not:\ file\ silently\ \(every\ record\ is\ confirmed\ first
file\ only\ on\ their\ yes

rules.rule: The confirm question offers file, change, or drop, not a bare File it?
must: file\ it,\ change\ something\ first,\ or\ drop\ it
rather\ than\ a\ bare\ "File\ it\?"

rules.rule: Never report_gap without draft: true; only a draft is discardable
must: `report_gap`\ without\ `draft:\ true`\ is\ never\ called
Only\ a\ draft\ is\ discardable

rules.rule: Capture is a light draft, no grill, no filing, no drain
must: capture\ a\ light\ draft,\ no\ interruption
no\ user\ interruption,\ no\ grill,\ no\ filing

rules.rule: An SRD gap is never filed as a doc gap
must: file\ an\ SRD\ gap
An\ SRD\ gap\ \(unmet\ `STR\-\*`/`STA\-\*`\ rules

rules.rule: A deferred or unknown platform question is filed here as a gap with answer set, never written to the KB
must: A\ platform\ question\ SRD\ work\ leaves\ open\ is\ a\ gap\ too,\ marked\ by\ `answer`
Both\ are\ filed\ here,\ never\ written\ to\ the\ KB

rules.rule: A store error is reported, never retried or worked around
must: report\ it,\ never\ retry\ or\ work\ around\ it

rules.rule: detail is the floor; never file without it
must: never\ file\ without\ it

rules.rule: Query every gap before capturing and merge a same-fact draft rather than duplicate
must: run\ `list_gaps`\ with\ `query`\ the\ topic\ and\ detail\ words,\ no\ `status`\ or\ `srd_ref`\ filter
merge\ into\ it\ with\ `update_gap`\ rather\ than\ duplicate
keep\ the\ `doc_id`/`heading_path`\ already\ set

rules.rule: A same-fact open gap gets add_hit, never a new record
must: `open`:\ `update_gap`\ with\ `add_hit:\ true`

rules.rule: A filled gap whose sections lack the fact is reopened only through a confirmed draft
must: capture\ a\ draft\ whose\ `detail`\ opens\ `Reopens\ gap\-NNNN:`
on\ yes,\ `reopen_gap`\ on\ `gap\-NNNN`

rules.rule: A discard is a decision; topic recorded in the caller's output
must: A\ discard\ is\ a\ decision,\ not\ a\ deletion
Nothing\ durable\ is\ written\ for\ it
Run\ the\ gate\ first

rules.rule: Filing only records the gap; corpus unchanged
must: Filing\ only\ records\ the\ gap;\ the\ corpus\ is\ unchanged

rules.rule: Never fills or wontfixes a gap; that is srd:backlog
must: fill\ a\ gap,\ or\ close\ it\ as\ wontfix\ \(that\ is\ `srd:backlog`\)

rules.rule: A cut requirement's or REJECTED SRD's KB-section gap arrives confirmed: kind wrong, submitted at once, no grill
must: A\ KB\ section\ left\ behind\ by\ a\ cut\ requirement\ \(or\ an\ abandoned\ SRD\)\ arrives\ confirmed
`kind:\ wrong`
then\ file\ at\ once\ —\ no\ grill,\ no\ phase\ D
from\ `srd:backlog`'s\ sweep,\ by\ the\ SRD's\ `REJECTED`\ Status

rules.rule: A gap's doc_id is the result's id, never its path
must: the\ `id`,\ never\ the\ `path`,\ even\ when\ they\ differ

rules.rule: No hard-coded trust order or folder name
A dedup match merges ask: existing names first, new ones appended ignoring case, none dropped; a new name makes the gap deferred and clears asked
must: pass\ the\ existing\ names\ followed\ by\ each\ new\ one\ not\ already\ there,\ ignoring\ case;\ never\ drop\ a\ name
A\ name\ the\ gap\ lacked\ also\ sets\ `answer:\ deferred`\ when\ the\ gap\ is\ `unknown`\ or\ plain,\ and\ clears\ `asked`\ \(`asked:\ ""`\)
`asked`\ —\ never\ set\ to\ a\ date\ here,\ only\ cleared\ by\ an\ `ask`\ merge
